module: Node "Bus Controls Detection" (category `repeat_instant`, bus icon). Reads the state of a bus: outputs `isKneeling` (bool, bus kneeling) and `doorsOpen` (bool, doors open), with an output flow `flow`. Input pins: `flow`, `vehId` (default 0). To be used with the "Register Bus Data" node called after the bus spawns. Reads `mgr.modules.vehicle:isBusKneel/isBusDoorOpen`.
notes: Without a prior call to Register Bus Data, the values stay false.
The "player vehicle" fallback announced in the pin description depends on the vehicle module (`isBusKneel(nil)`), not verified here.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (returned by `_flowgraph_createNode(C)`). Definition fields: name, description, category, pinSchema, tags.

executionStarted.desc: Resets both outputs to false at start (note: name without underscore, so never called by the manager, which calls `_executionStarted`).

work.desc: Updates `isKneeling`, `doorsOpen` from the manager's `vehicle` module and activates the output flow.
